title: ICAN Full Suspension Carbon Fat Bike SN04 Review

takeaways.text: The frame takes 4.8-inch Schwalbe Jumbo Jim tires, and the full-carbon frame including pivots uses a tapered head tube for a suspension fork.
As built with a dropper post, carbon rims and an Eagle drivetrain, his bike weighed 31 lb.
Routing is internal throughout except at the rear brake; it uses 12×197 mm rear and 15×150 mm front thru-axles.

disclosure: Video from 2017; the presenter says he has bought several ICAN products. Whether the current SN04 frame has changed since then is not established.
summary: An early review of an ICAN SN04 full-carbon, full-suspension fat bike built for snow riding.
